items.mainDefect: Appending to contents mutates the caller's string.

secondary.defect: Appending to frozen contents raises FrozenError.
Appending to nil contents raises NoMethodError.

items.mainDefect: Interpolating request.referer into JavaScript without escaping allows string breakout and XSS.

secondary.defect: Using the full referer URL as targetOrigin prevents resize messages from being delivered.
A nil referer produces an empty targetOrigin without a fallback.

items.mainDefect: Interpolating an unescaped external URL into HTML allows attribute breakout.

secondary.defect: Bypassing sanitization through raw_html and raw rendering permits unsafe URLs such as javascript: links.

items.mainDefect: Unrescued feed-fetching and RSS-parsing errors crash the scheduled job.

secondary.defect: The job does not guard against a nil rss.items collection.
Calling scrub on nil item content raises NoMethodError and aborts importing.

items.mainDefect: Unrescued network errors from open(url).read crash the RetrieveTopic job.

secondary.defect: Nil Readability content reaches import and raises NoMethodError when appended to.
The remote import assumes Readability returns a non-nil title without guarding that assumption.

items.mainDefect: Invalid-host tests can exercise the throttle branch instead of the intended host-validation branch.

secondary.defect: Unisolated Redis setnx and expire operations can pollute other tests.
